mode: image2image (vanilla CSFF card art as style reference)
prompt:
Use the attached reference images.
Reference images 1 and 2 are style references only: match their flat posterized colour fills in a few hard-edged tonal steps, thin dark ink outlines, small ink tick and hatch marks for texture, and muted naturalistic palette of moss greens, earth browns and grey stone; do not copy their subjects.
Reference image 3 is the composition to keep: keep this exact subject and layout (a ring of tall grey standing stones in a forest clearing, a path running through the middle, trees close around) but redraw it entirely in the style of references 1 and 2.
Subject: a ring of tall grey standing stones in a clearing of the wood, each leaning a little toward the next, green moss on their faces, a few faint runes cut low on one stone, the ground in the centre of the ring bare and flattened.
A full-bleed painted game card scene filling the whole 2:3 portrait canvas edge to edge, realistic proportions, flat cel-like colour, no soft gradients, no watercolour bleed, no paper texture, no glow, no glossy highlights, no people, no text, no border, no frame.
Avoid: glowing runes, orange lichen, autumn colours, blue flowers, watercolour, soft painterly shading, sunbeams, photo, 3D render, pixel art, white margin, text, watermark
note: Owner-approved 2026-10-10 in the Card Art Restyle Review (restyle toward vanilla card art). Finished by /process-card-art --full-bleed.
